description: Generates a CHORD on a simple (sine-table) waveform from a text datafile of FREQUENCIES in Hz - submode 2 of synth chord (sibling submode 1 takes MIDI values; all other behavior re-verified identical in this submode). A pure generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0). Frequencies render exactly: a 261.63/329.63/392.0 file shows FFT peaks at exactly those frequencies, and the render differs from submode 1's equal-tempered 60/64/67 as it should. Values refuse per-value ('ERROR: Value 1 (30000.000000) is out of range.'); 5 Hz accepted (sub-audio partials are legal). Duration sample-exact from dur; deterministic; amp default is 0.3 not the banner's 1.0 (divergence pinned in submode 1, re-verified here); no breakpoint-capable parameters; chans 1-16 dual-mono.
musical_use: The just-intonation sibling: submode 1 thinks in note numbers, this one thinks in Hz - so exact harmonic-series chords (100/200/300/500), ratio tunings (3:2, 7:4), and deliberately beating near-unisons (440 + 441.5 = 1.5 Hz beat) are all directly writable. Sub-audio values are accepted, so a 'chord' can include an LFO-rate partial for slow amplitude undulation. Deterministic and sample-exact: ideal for tuning references, difference-tone experiments, and beds to feed filter bank or waveset distortion. Keep amp at 0.3-0.6 for layering.

datafile.description: REQUIRED text datafile of frequency values in Hz (one chord; all values sound together), whitespace/newline separated; ';' comments allowed (verified in submode 1, same parser). Out-of-range values refuse per-value ('Value 1 (30000.000000) is out of range.'); 5 Hz accepted. Write via write_data_file.

srate.description: Output sample rate - range gate 16000-96000 (refusal verbatim in submode 1, same parser). Positional - always emitted (default 44100).

chans.description: Output channel count 1-16 (banner claims '1, 2 or 4'); multichannel is dual-mono (verified in submode 1).

dur.description: Output duration in seconds, sample-exact (2.0 -> 88200 frames verified in this submode). CDP-enforced 0.04-7200. Required.

amp.description: Output amplitude = final peak, CDP-enforced 0-1. Real flagless default is 0.3 (banner's '1.0 max & default' is wrong - pinned in submode 1). Entry default 0.5, always emitted. Breakpoints refused.

tabsize.description: Wavetable size 256-4096, default 4096, rounded to a multiple of 4; smaller tables verified to change the render (submode 1).

examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('harm110.txt', '110 220 330 440 550'). Exact integer-ratio chord - no equal-temperament rounding.
beat15.txt: '440 441.5'. A 1.5 Hz amplitude beat - difference-tone demo or tuning drone.

known_issues: Same pins as submode 1, re-verified where behavior could differ: amp flagless default 0.3 (banner wrong), -a0 = digital silence, no breakpoint-capable params, chans 1-16 dual-mono, deterministic.
Frequency values refuse per-value ('Value 1 (30000.000000) is out of range.'); very low values (5 Hz) are accepted - sub-audio 'partials' modulate rather than sound.
Mode 1 (MIDI 60/64/67) and mode 2 (261.63/329.63/392.0) renders differ as expected - MIDI conversion vs exact Hz.
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries (arity_zero_unsupported).
